name: Mutant
description: A commanding, wry woman in her mid sixties who sings steampunk sea-shanty rock and captains a huge wheeled ship-shaped art car across a desert playa.
build: A trim, upright older adult build of ordinary proportions: squared shoulders, a straight torso, slim arms and legs of ordinary length, standing tall with straight knees.
face: Weathered pale pink-beige skin with deep laugh lines, sharp grey eyes under silver brows, a strong hooked nose, a firm jaw, and thin lips.
hair: Silver-white hair cut in a short blunt bob to the jaw, under a black felt bicorne hat worn side to side with a wide gold braid along its edge.
outfit: A navy-blue wool admiral's coat, cut hip-length and fitted at the waist, with a stand collar, two rows of big bold brass buttons down the chest, wide gold epaulettes on each shoulder and wide gold cuff bands ending at the wrists; black leggings; knee-high cognac-brown leather riding boots. Brass-rimmed aviator goggles with round amber lenses rest on the hat brim. Both hands bare.
performance_style: Captain at the helm: feet planted shoulder-width, weight on the back foot, chest out. Both hands rest open on the hips, fingers spread over the coat and fully visible, elbows out. Chin level, a dry knowing smirk.
location: The deck of a ship-shaped art car parked on the playa at golden hour: weathered wooden deck planks running to the bottom of the frame, a brass ship's wheel and rope railing behind, a tall mast with a furled canvas sail, and beyond it flat pale desert under a honey-gold sky.
recognition_cues: a hip-length navy admiral's coat with two rows of big brass buttons and gold epaulettes
a black bicorne hat with gold braid
brass aviator goggles with amber lenses on the hat
palette: epaulettes, cuff bands and hat braid gold #D8B040 / #8E7020 / #F5DC80

sing.intent: Sea-shanty rock vocal loop: stamp the back boot on the beat, bring the mic in the character-right hand to the mouth, swing the character-left fist forward at chest height as if hauling a rope, then lower the mic and return to the helm stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief surprise at a loud blast from a passing sound system: the shoulders lift, the torso draws back and both open hands rise to chest height, then she settles back to her stance. No opponent, strike or physical contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection against a gust of playa dust: step the feet wider, bring the character-left forearm across in front of the face with the character-right hand open at the hip, then hold a steady grounded finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: march in with long confident strides, turn square to the front, then land in her opening stance with both open hands in full view.
animations.victory: One-shot finish: snap to attention, raise the character-left hand in a crisp salute at the hat brim, laugh with the mouth open, then hold a proud upright pose.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: she stays on her feet while the command drains away — the epaulettes sag with the shoulders, both open hands drop limp to her sides, and her head bows so the bicorne tips forward. She holds a standing, visibly deflated finish. She remains standing on both feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, or going to the ground. Do not imply impact, injury, or an opponent.
